routines.semantics: Call the appropriate N0067 configurable solver with caller-provided steps, refinements, progress handlers and interruption. Snapshot confinement and publish complete results to the original generation-checked window.

scenarios.observes: Records all callback inputs in order and both complete caller windows.
Records all callback inputs in order and both complete caller windows.

routines.edgeAssessment: Cover both the normal search with progress and the first requested bail with a pre-populated result window.
routines.errorAssessment: The shim validates the tolerance, closed/aliased windows, workspace and callback return values. Host adapters preserve the original thrown callback error.
routines.fixtureRationale: Reuse the authored audit geometry, frame and FOV kernels already referenced by the baseline visibility comparisons.
routines.cleanup: Restore callback frames on scope exit. Allocate private input and result windows and release both after success, interruption or failure.
routines.tolerance: Use the repository recursive comparison for the recorded numeric endpoints; compare callback order, type and text exactly.
